## Overview

`lifewatt` maps a US ZIP code to environmental justice indicators:

- average residential electricity price, and its YoY / MoM trend;
- average life expectancy, and its YoY / MoM trend.

## Planned workflow

```{r eval = FALSE}
library(lifewatt)

electricity_price("32601")
electricity_price_trend("32601", period = "yoy")

life_expectancy("32601")
life_expectancy_trend("32601", period = "mom")
```

This vignette is a placeholder and will be expanded once the functions are
implemented.
